name: same-session-computer-use
description: Add parallel exact background capture and window-targeted input for Codex on Hyprland.

interface.shortDescription: Parallel background control for Hyprland apps.
interface.longDescription: Extends the bundled Computer Use plugin on Hyprland with task-owned window claims, exact background capture, targeted shortcuts, and window-local click, scroll, and drag controls. Independent agents can operate different windows concurrently while same-window and broker global-seat operations remain coordinated.
defaultPrompt: Use my existing logged-in app to complete this task in the background.
Show me an exact screenshot of one of my real application windows.
Operate this app without moving my pointer or changing my workspace.
